mechanism.claim: Aggressive quote flow is informative when its sign and magnitude consistently align with the following five-minute bar's price response rather than merely its own bar. In a tail coherence onset, follow the final hour's aggregate aggressive-flow direction for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of aggregate signed taker quote flow over the final twelve completed five-minute bars
mechanism.why_distinct: LFIC measures one-bar-lagged flow-to-price transmission across 71 ordered pairs. It is not contemporaneous taker positioning, aggressor VWAP contradiction, aggregate flow confirmation, ticket expansion, funding, or a fitted model.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: persistent lagged impact should identify directional price discovery during volatile auctions; causal RV20 q90 is only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: joint tail on lagged coherence and recent-flow magnitude, plus onset and twelve-hour reservation

features.lagged_pairs: exactly 71 ordered pairs of bar_flow[i] with next_bar_return[i+1]
features.coherence_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 540 valid decisions, minimum 360, current excluded, rank>=0.80
features.recent_flow_magnitude_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(recent_flow) over at most 540 valid decisions, minimum 360, current excluded, rank>=0.65
features.onset: joint eligible state true and immediately preceding four-hour decision false
features.source_valid: each five-minute aggregate has exactly five unique coherent finite positive-OHLC one-minute rows, finite nonnegative quote/taker quote, taker quote<=quote volume, positive quote volume; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: exact 4-hour UTC boundary after all 72 bars complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.contemporaneous_coherence: same formula pairing flow and return in the same completed bar
definitions.no_flow_magnitude_tail: positive lagged-coherence tail onset without recent-flow rank
definitions.stale_recent_flow: primary eligibility but side from the preceding completed hour's aggregate flow

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no lag, rank, history, onset, block, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
